# SG Car Workshop

> A directory of car workshops and car services in Singapore, run by Page One Singapore. Entries use details confirmed by each business. No rankings and no rating or review markup.

Last updated: 2026-11-01

## Services
- [Spray painting and bodywork](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/services/spray-painting-bodywork/): Respray, colour change and body kit work in a spray booth.
- [Gearbox repair](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/services/gearbox-repair/): Automatic gearbox diagnosis, repair, servicing and upgrades.
- [ABS, ECU and module repair](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/services/abs-ecu-module-repair/): Repair of ABS pumps and control modules instead of costly replacement.
- [Car battery replacement](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/services/car-battery/): Battery testing and replacement, at a workshop or where your car is.
- [Car detailing and coating](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/services/car-detailing-coating/): Grooming, steam cleaning, fumigation and odour removal for your car.
- [Car wrap and PPF](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/services/car-wrap-ppf/): Colour change wraps, paint protection film and window film.
- [Car parts](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/services/car-parts/): Parts shops for specific makes, with models and part types to browse.
- [General servicing and repair](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/services/general-servicing-repair/): Everyday servicing and repairs: battery checks, alternators, aircon and more.

- [Wrapstar Autostyle](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/workshops/wrapstar-autostyle/): Car wrap and PPF, Premium, Yishun (own website: https://wrapstarautostyle.com/)

- [Cleanic Detailing](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/sgcarworkshop/workshops/cleanic-detailing/): Car detailing and coating, Premium, Mobile service, island-wide (own website: https://cleanicdetailing.com/)
